reviews.comment: Lectures were hybrid. Attendance not mandatory, all of the recorded classes are shared with students. Grading is curved at the final test followed by an oral exam, but it is not guaranteed. It is easy to get B, but requires a lot of work to get A. However, he is very helpful and explains everything very clearly. Absolutely love this professor.

Dr. Tsvetkov was one of the best professors I've had. He teaches the material based on how quickly the class is learning it, so if there are some difficult concepts he'll spend one or two more classes teaching it rather than skim over it. He reviews every assignment that gets submitted and conducts excellent reviews before midterms/finals.
Overall great professor. Very knowledgeable and willing to do his part to help you understand material.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES
